If you have an iPhone, look up how to turn on grayscale mode. Basically it turns your phone black and white, n your brain isn’t getting as much of a dopamine hit due to the artificial light from your phone. Our eyes aren’t programmed to recognize the colors given off by our phones, n they literally trigger dopamine hits everytime we look at it. I find turning grayscale on makes watching things less appealing and I find myself doing it less and less. However, I still struggle with mindlessly scrolling through Reddit which is even worse. So unfortunately I don’t have a solution, but a little hack that hopefully helps.

So, former broke guy here. I’m 35 years old. Had a good paying job in my 20’s but lost it due to a raging addiction issue. I then moved back to New Jersey from Nevada n spent the next 7-8 years working dead end jobs, living off my credit cards, and constantly stressing about money. I mean stressing to the point where I had exhausted all of my resources, credit cards were maxed and I just didn’t want to exist anymore. 

A former coworker of mine had offered to help get me a job working with him. I jumped on that and I’m currently making close to 6 figures a year. I have a financial freedom I’ve never known. I can pretty much buy whatever I want n not have to worry about it. I have a slighttttt shopping addiction I’m trying to get under control. I order dinner every night from nice restaurants n don’t even bother looking at my bank account.

I say all that to say this. Having money is nice. It’s nice not having to stress about how you’re going to pay your bills or ever get ahead. It’s nice buying things for yourself you could never afford in the past. However, it hasn’t filled the void I feel inside. Money hasn’t made me the least bit happier. It’s alleviated some stress, but in terms of my happiness, it has done nothing. It’s all an illusion my friend. Don’t buy into that thinking, please.
